title: Nutty Smoked Greek Pork Kebabs
description: A monsoon Greek dish featuring pork tenderloin, with a buttery and glassy-jelly texture, smoke-hot flavor, and kosher-friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a dinner gathering.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, honey, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork tenderloin pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pork is cooked through to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and chopped walnuts.
